class.name: CbItemLook
class.brief_description: How a kind of held item looks: the scene drawn in its holder's socket.
class.description: Put it in a world reactions scene ([code]vfx/reactions_*.tscn[/code]). The scene is the item's frame (the socket's): the grip at the origin, pointing along -Z.
